description: This file defines the sysinfo class which provides methods to gather system information on Windows NT systems via WMI. It includes methods to retrieve hostname, IP address, kernel version, system uptime, resource usage, device lists, filesystem info, etc.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving various system information on Windows NT systems using WMI.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WMI COM object.

methods.name: _GetWMI
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified WMI class, optionally filtering properties.

methods.name: _devicelist
methods.description: Returns a list of device names filtered by device type.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname of the system.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the system.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Returns the kernel version and service pack.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users or 'N.A.' for unsupported systems.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns processor load percentages, optionally as a bar.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Returns information about CPU(s).

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Returns a list of PCI devices.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Returns a list of IDE devices.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Returns a list of SCSI devices.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Returns a list of USB devices.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Returns a list of SBus devices (not called).

methods.name: network
methods.description: Returns network interface metrics such as rx/tx bytes, packets, errors, and drops.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Returns total and free RAM, swap space, and detailed memory info.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Returns information about mounted filesystems.

methods.name: distro
methods.description: Returns the OS caption information.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns an icon filename representing the OS.
